description: Use the host-supplied corrected HSTU cold start for sequential recommendation across Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics, and CDs_and_Vinyl. Train one independent HSTU model per category and select changes using macro-average validation HR@10.
motivation: Establish a controlled HSTU baseline so improvements reflect model or training changes under fixed data splits, seeds, evaluation candidates, and compute limits.
implementation_notes: Preserve the HSTU backbone, category routing, preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, maximum 200 epochs, and 200 batches per epoch. Read DATA_DIR from os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'] and save artifacts beneath the trial directory. Histories are left-padded; read out the final nonpadding position, never count-1. Keep the trained architecture, checkpoint, and embedded predictor consistent. Preserve ModelView compatibility and the required diagnosis adapter interfaces. Each category must load exactly one trained model; independent-model fusion is prohibited. Only public histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps are available. The supplied description contains no baseline code, detailed HSTU architecture, or measured results.
pseudocode:
set preprocessing_seed = 0 and training_seed = 42
for category in the four required categories:
    load the supplied fixed splits from GAGC_DATA_DIR
    initialize the corrected host HSTU model
    train on left-padded histories for at most 200 epochs, 200 batches per epoch
    save one selected model checkpoint beneath the trial directory
write a category-routed predictor matching the trained architecture
host evaluates validation HR@10 using its pinned candidate protocol
compare trials by mean validation HR@10 across all four categories

originality.positive: Provides a carefully constrained, family-specific experimental baseline.
originality.negative: No new architectural or optimization mechanism is described. Scores use a 1–10 scale.

future_potential.positive: Supports controlled exploration of HSTU architecture, losses, sampling, and optimization within a single trained model per category.
future_potential.negative: No measured validation evidence establishes improvement, and exploration shares a 43,200 GPU-second budget.

code_difficulty.positive: The supplied corrected baseline and fixed evaluator reduce initial implementation work.
code_difficulty.negative: Architecture changes require synchronized training, checkpoint loading, prediction, padding handling, and diagnostic interfaces.
